faq.question: Is this an earnings stock news API?
faq.answer: Yes. It collects earnings-related headlines as structured JSON via the earnings preset and an earnings event-type filter.

faq.question: How does the earnings filter work?
faq.answer: Stories are tagged for events like earnings; this task keeps items with the earnings event type so results noise is lower than a full market feed.

faq.question: Do I need to change any input before starting?
faq.answer: No. Click Start for the last 48 hours of earnings headlines (up to 50 items). Duplicate to add tickers or Only new articles.

faq.question: Can I alert only on new earnings headlines?
faq.answer: Yes. Duplicate this task, turn on Only new articles, and schedule it for Slack, Zapier, or webhook alerts.
